title: AI SDLC profile
description: One person's way of working on one machine, with a section for each repository they run stories in. Lives at profile.json in the AI SDLC home (AI_SDLC_HOME, default ~/.ai-sdlc). Never committed and never written into a repository. Holds names, commands, and settings only, never credentials.

ownerName.description: The person the skills call "the owner".

crossModelReviewAuthorized.description: Whether plans and code may be sent to additional model providers for critique and review.

sharedResources.description: Local services, databases, ports, or hosts that parallel stories must not fight over.

defaultVerificationEnvironment.description: Where before-and-after and live tests run by default.

declinedComponents.description: Optional components the owner chose not to install, such as hyperframes or ffmpeg, so the check stops raising them.

implementationLevel.description: The ponytail level the implementation phase uses. Default: full.

reviewRoundLimit.description: How many times review may return a story to build before the owner is asked how to proceed. Default: 3.

beforeAndAfter.description: Whether a story captures a before-and-after comparison: always, never, or ask during planning. Default: ask.

architectureDiagram.description: Whether the pull request description gets an architecture diagram: always, never, or ask during planning. Default: ask.

commandCenterPath.description: The folder that holds the Command Center files Jarvis runs: the software-factory checkout, or the extension folder for a harness that needs copies. Setup saves what detect reports; the check refuses a folder that no longer holds them.

workerPermissions.description: What a story worker started from the command line may do without asking. restricted: edit files in its worktree and run git, gh, node, and the programs the gates use. unrestricted: run anything. Default: restricted.

adapters.description: Answers that only one agent harness needs, keyed by adapter folder name. Each adapter's setup document defines its own section.

repos.description: The owner's settings for each repository, keyed by owner/name.

schemaVersion.description: Accepted from profiles saved before the two schemas were merged.

gates.description: Checks that must pass before a pull request opens. A command string makes the gate required; null means the owner decided it is not required. {files} is replaced with the changed production files.

branchPattern.description: How a story's branch is named. {id} is replaced with the work item id and {slug} with a short form of its title. Default: story/{id}-{slug}.

worktreeRoot.description: The folder each story's worktree is created in, as <worktreeRoot>/<branch>. Default: a folder named <repository>-worktrees beside the repository.

teamRules.description: How this repository's team works, for the agent to follow: each entry is a web address, a file path, or an instruction written out. Read at planning and again when addressing pull request comments.

readiness.description: The read-only check that a story is finished in the team's work tracker. Leave out, or set tracker to none, for a repository without one.

tracker.description: Where the repository's stories are tracked.

effortField.description: Azure DevOps field that holds a story's effort. Default: Microsoft.VSTS.Scheduling.StoryPoints.

unestimatedValue.description: The effort value that means not estimated yet. Default: null.

closedTaskStates.description: Task states that count as finished. Default: Closed, Done.

targetBranch.description: The branch a story's pull requests must be merged into. Default: main.

checklist.description: The checks that apply. Default: prMergedToTarget, prLinked, userConfirm.

handoffTaskTitle.description: Title of the task that records the story was handed off for final review, if the team uses one.

handoffAssignee.description: Who that handoff task is assigned to.

phases.description: Console phases at which Jarvis runs the check. Default: ci, merge, closed.

requiredPipelines.description: CI pipelines that must succeed on the pull request head before it is reported ready.

reviewBot.description: Automated PR reviewer to iterate with after the pull request opens.

specDir.description: Where the approved spec is committed. null keeps the spec out of the repository and puts it in the pull request description instead.

crossModelReviewAuthorized.description: Set false to forbid sending this repository's plans and code to additional model providers, whatever the top-level setting says.
